source.working_tree_changes: mode-block primal preconditioner plus dense gauge Schur diagnostic

preconditioner.type: P8 independent primal mode blocks with dense Schur complement for gauge multipliers

decision: Reject. The approximate primal inverse induces an extremely ill-conditioned gauge Schur complement and does not yield a usable true-residual solve. This bounded dense diagnostic is not a production preconditioner.
limitations: This is a linear preconditioner diagnostic only; no correction is applied.
The constraint matrix and Schur complement are materialized only for this bounded experiment.
